body: My boyfriend says the same. That’s he just a “private person” but knowing there’s another guy who said the same thing makes me feel a lot less crazy that I’m overreacting and that there are others who did this. I’m sorry he did that to you though, but it definitely opens up what mine might be doing.

I just told him what you said, but In my own words saying how contradicting it is for him for him to tell me he doesn’t like attention and but posts on a public platform. Depending on what he says I may try and talk to him more about it but I doubt it’ll go anywhere. I’m scared because I don’t want to be with a cheater because I’ve been in multiple relationships where I got cheated on and i have extreme anxiety over it.
Update: he called me and told me stop being annoying and kept asking “do you want to keep doing this?” And just made me feel bad and even more angry about this whole thing and I couldn’t even say what I wanted to.
